1-800-GOT-JUNK Review: Is It Worth the Price?

If you have a pile of junk that needs to disappear, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? is probably the first name that comes to mind. But is it actually worth it? After researching the service thoroughly, here's the honest answer.

Get a Free Quote from 1-800-GOT-JUNK? →

What Is 1-800-GOT-JUNK?

1-800-GOT-JUNK? is North America's largest junk removal franchise, founded in 1989 in Vancouver, Canada. They operate in hundreds of cities across the US, Canada, and Australia. Their model is simple: you point at what you want gone, they haul it away.

How Does 1-800-GOT-JUNK Work?

  • Book online or call — Schedule a 2-hour arrival window
  • Free on-site estimate — Crew arrives, assesses the job, gives you a price
  • You approve — No obligation until you say yes
  • They haul it — Everything removed, truck swept clean

1-800-GOT-JUNK Pricing

Pricing is based on how much truck space your junk takes up. A minimum load starts around $150-200, while a full truck typically runs $400-600+. Prices vary by location and item type.

What Do They Take?

Almost everything: furniture, appliances, electronics, yard waste, renovation debris, hot tubs, mattresses, and more. They do NOT take hazardous materials like paint, chemicals, or asbestos.

Pros

  • Fast and convenient — often same-day availability
  • Upfront pricing before you commit
  • Takes almost anything
  • Eco-conscious — donates and recycles where possible
  • Insured and professional crew

Cons

  • More expensive than DIY or dumpster rental
  • Pricing not available online — requires on-site estimate
  • Not available in all areas

Is It Worth It?

For most people, yes. The convenience of having a professional crew show up, do all the heavy lifting, and haul everything away in one trip is worth the premium over alternatives. If you're short on time, physically unable to move heavy items, or have a large amount of junk, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? is hard to beat.
